title: Account Security / Human Escalation
guidance: Suspected account compromise, MFA takeover, and identity-verification issues require human handling.
The POC must not request passwords, MFA codes, security answers, or sensitive personal information.
Use authorized HCC support channels for account-security actions.
source_name: Houston City College — Student Email/Eagle ID

title: Eagle Online (Canvas) Support
guidance: HCC identifies Eagle Online as its Canvas learning management system.
The Canvas username is the student's HCC email, and the Canvas password is the same as the HCC email password.
For Canvas browser problems, HCC recommends a current browser with pop-ups, JavaScript, and cookies enabled.
For Eagle Online technical support, HCC lists 713-718-5275, option 3.
For password reset assistance, HCC lists 713-718-8800.
HCC states that a submitted Canvas support ticket should receive contact within 24 hours.
source_name: Houston City College — Eagle Online (Canvas) Support

title: Password Reset Information
guidance: HCC provides a self-service password management page for password resets.
If an account is disabled after repeated unsuccessful login attempts, HCC says the user may wait for the temporary lockout period or contact the IT Help Desk.
The POC must not reset passwords, unlock accounts, perform identity verification, or request passwords.
source_name: Houston City College — Password Reset Information

title: Student Email / Eagle ID
guidance: HCC provides official Student Email and Eagle ID support information.
HCC states that assisted password resets require identity verification by an HCC representative.
HCC lists the IT Service Desk at 713-718-8800.
The POC must route identity-verification and assisted-reset actions to authorized HCC staff.
source_name: Houston City College — Student Email/Eagle ID

title: Technology Support
guidance: HCC's Technology Support page routes students to Student Email/Eagle ID, Password Reset, Student System, Eagle Online (Canvas), and other support resources.
The POC should use these official routes rather than inventing internal support procedures.

title: Canvas Browser Requirements
guidance: For Canvas issues, HCC recommends a current browser.
HCC states that pop-ups, JavaScript, and cookies must be enabled for Canvas.
If the problem persists or appears account-specific, route the student to HCC technical support.
source_name: Houston City College — Eagle Online (Canvas) Support

title: Technology Support
guidance: The public HCC Technology Support page includes technology support resources and information about Wi-Fi access.
The POC should avoid inventing internal network settings or credentials and should escalate unresolved connectivity problems.
